title: 第20章断剑
novel_title: 凡人修仙：从废器房杂役开始
content_zh:
陈青山进执事堂时，柳青霜已经在里面。

    孙执事坐在案后，手边放着一本厚册子，册角磨得发白。

    柳青霜站在窗边，只看他。

    陈青山行礼。

    “孙执事，柳师姐。”

    孙执事笑道：“别紧张，问几句话。”

    问几句话。

    铁三爷以前也爱这么说。说完就是罚半月月俸。

    柳青霜翻开出入册。

    纸页哗啦一声。

    “昨夜亥时后，你在何处？”

    陈青山低头道：“在丁七号炼器。”

    “谁能作证？”

    “隔壁周小满闻见炉味。”

    孙执事笑眯眯地插了一句：“周小满一早是说过，你屋里呛得很。”

    柳青霜又问：“炼什么？”

    陈青山取出那块歪铜胚，放到案上。

    砰。

    铜胚砸得案面轻轻一震。

    边角起毛，表面坑坑洼洼，丑得很结实。

    孙执事拿起来看了看，嘴角抽了一下。

    “这炼得……”

    他到底没把后半句说出来。

    陈青山低声道：“弟子手艺浅，昨夜想试铜胚淬火，火候没压住，废了。”

    柳青霜的目光落到他肩背。

    “伤也是炼出来的？”

    “炉火窜了。”

    屋里静了一下。

    柳青霜走近两步。

    她没有碰伤口，手停在他肩侧。

    陈青山背上的肉立刻绷住。

    “炉火窜伤，多在前胸、手臂。”柳青霜道，“你这伤在背后。”

    “炉架倒了。”陈青山道，“弟子躲的时候蹭上去，后头又撞了炉角。”

    他顿了顿，又补了一句：“屋里那只旧炉底座本就不稳。师姐若不信，可派人去看。”

    孙执事轻咳一声。

    柳青霜看着他。

    “昨夜你可曾出山？”

    “没有。”

    这两个字不能犹豫。

    柳青霜盯了他一会儿。

    “抬头。”

    陈青山抬头。

    她的眼睛很冷。

    “你的气息厚了些。”

    陈青山脸上露出一点苦笑。

    “昨夜炼废以后，弟子怕今日误事，吞了一粒回气丹。”

    “哪来的？”

    “青石镇坊市买的。”

    孙执事翻了翻册子，道：“前几日领过月俸，又接了灵蜂任务，买粒回气丹也说得过去。”

    柳青霜合上册子。

    啪。

    “三日内，把这块铜胚的复炼记录交给我。”

    陈青山眼角轻轻一跳。

    这不是放过他。

    这是又拴了一根绳。

    “弟子明白。”

    出了执事堂，陈青山没回丁七号，直接去了器峰后坡。

    周伯的院子里还是一股铁锈味。

    老头蹲在炉边，拿小刻刀刮一柄断剑。

    剑断成两截，放在灰布上。断口处灵纹乱成一团。

    周伯头也没抬。

    “被问了？”

    陈青山脚步一顿。

    “师父怎么知道？”

    “你走路比早上轻，说明伤没好。衣服换了，说明见了人。怀里还揣着东西，八成是拿去糊弄人的玩意儿。”

    陈青山把铜胚放到桌上。
content_en:
When Chen Qingshan entered the Deacon Hall, Liu Qingshuang was already inside.

    Deacon Sun was sitting behind the case, with a thick booklet in his hand, the corners of which were worn white.

    Liu Qingshuang stood by the window and only looked at him.

    Chen Qingshan saluted.

    "Deacon Sun, Senior Sister Liu."

    Deacon Sun smiled and said: "Don't be nervous, just ask a few questions."

    Ask a few words.

    Tie Sanye also liked to say this before. After that, he was fined half a month's salary.

    Liu Qingshuang opened the entry and exit book.

    The page clattered.

    "Where were you after midnight last night?"

    Chen Qingshan lowered his head and said: "Refining weapons at Ding No. 7."

    "Who can testify?"

    "Zhou Xiaoman smelled the stove next door."

    Deacon Sun smiled and added: "Zhou Xiaoman said early in the morning that there was a lot of choking in your room."

    Liu Qingshuang asked again: "What to practice?"

    Chen Qingshan took out the crooked copper embryo and put it on the table.

    Bang.

    The copper embryo hit the table and shook slightly.

    The corners were fluffy, the surface was pitted, and it was ugly and solid.

    Deacon Sun picked it up and looked at it, and the corner of his mouth twitched.

    "This is how you practice..."

    He didn't say the second half of the sentence.

    Chen Qingshan whispered: "My disciple's skills are not good. I wanted to try quenching the copper embryo last night, but the heat was not suppressed, so it was useless."

    Liu Qingshuang's eyes fell on his shoulder.

    "The injuries are also caused by tempering?"

    "The fire is burning."

    There was silence in the room.

    Liu Qingshuang took two steps closer.

    She didn't touch the wound, her hand rested on his shoulder.

    The flesh on Chen Qingshan's back immediately tensed up.

    "The injuries from the fire are mostly on the chest and arms." Liu Qingshuang said, "Your injuries are on the back."

    "The stove fell down," Chen Qingshan said. "The disciple ran up against it while hiding, and hit the corner of the stove with his back."

    He paused and added: "The old stove base in the house is inherently unstable. If senior sister doesn't believe it, send someone to take a look."

    Deacon Sun coughed lightly.

    Liu Qingshuang looked at him.

    "Did you go out last night?"

    "No."

    These two words cannot be hesitated.

    Liu Qingshuang stared at him for a while.

    "Look up."

    Chen Qingshan raised his head.

    Her eyes were cold.

    "Your breath is thicker."

    Chen Qingshan had a wry smile on his face.

    "After refining the body last night, I was afraid that I would cause trouble today, so I swallowed a Qi Restoration Pill."

    "Where did it come from?"

    "I bought it from Qingshi Town."

    Deacon Sun flipped through the book and said, "I received my monthly salary a few days ago and took on the Spirit Bee mission. It makes sense to buy a Qi Restoring Pill."

    Liu Qingshuang closed the book.

    Snap.

    "Within three days, give me the refining record of this copper embryo."

    Chen Qingshan's eyes twitched slightly.

    This is not letting him go.

    This is another rope tied.

    "Disciple understands."

    After leaving the Deacon Hall, Chen Qingshan went directly to the back slope of Qi Peak without returning to Ding No. 7.

    Uncle Zhou's yard still smells like rust.

    The old man squatted by the stove and used a small carving knife to scrape off a broken sword.

    The sword was broken into two pieces and placed on the gray cloth. The spiritual patterns at the fracture were in a mess.

    Uncle Zhou didn't even raise his head.

    "Been asked?"

    Chen Qingshan paused.

    "How does Master know?"

    "The fact that you are walking lighter than in the morning means that your injury is not healed. You have changed your clothes, which means you have met someone. There are still things in your arms, which are probably used to fool people."

    Chen Qingshan put the copper embryo on the table.
